#this code matches the MCI and DOC causes of death to the template by matching cause with COD "manner" and specific cause information (illness, drug, homicide, suicide, etc.) with COD "cause"
```{r libraries and data}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
template<-read_xlsx("COD Coding Input template.xlsx")
combined<-read.csv("mci_doc_combined.csv")



```
looking at both cause_of_death and specific variables to see where missingness may lie
```{r counting}
combined%>%filter(is.na(cause_of_death))%>%count() #none are NA, but looking at the df, there are blanks

combined %>%
  filter(is.na(cause_of_death) | cause_of_death == "") %>%
  count() #7688 are blank 


combined %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cause_of_death),
    cause_of_death != "",
    if_any(
      c(illspec, drugspec, selfspec, accspec,
        suicspec, homispec, otherspec),
      ~ !is.na(.) & . != ""
    )
  ) %>%
  count() #15196 are captured in this 
```


fitting combined into template
```{r fitting}
template1 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,
    MANNER = cause_of_death,

   CAUSE = coalesce(
      illspec,
      drugspec,
      homispec,
      suicspec,
      selfspec,
      accspec,
      otherspec
    )
  )
write_xlsx(template1, "COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx")
```

checking the output
```{final cod}
cod_output1<-read_xlsx("final_cod_output.xlsx")

cod_output1%>%filter(is.na(MANNER) & is.na(CAUSE))%>%count()

#1  7688


cod_output1%>%filter(is.na(MANNER))%>%count() #7688
cod_output1%>%filter(is.na(CAUSE))%>%count() #37144 rough

cod_vars <- c(
  "ACCIDENT", "NATURAL", "HOMICIDE", "SUICIDE",
  "UNKNOWN", "PENDING", "PRELIM_OD",
  "PRELIM_HEAT", "PRELIM_COLD",
  "PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY", "PRELIM_HOMICIDE",
  "PRELIM_SUICIDE", "PRELIM_HEART",
  "PRELIM_ILLNESS", "PRELIM_FIREARM",
  "PRELIM_UNKNOWN", "FINAL_ACC_OD",
  "FINAL_ALL_OD", "FINAL_HEAT",
  "FINAL_HEAT_UNK", "FINAL_COLD",
  "FINAL_COLD_UNK", "FINAL_OTHER_INJURY",
  "FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK", "FINAL_HOMICIDE",
  "FINAL_SUICIDE", "FINAL_HEART",
  "FINAL_HEART_UNK", "FINAL_ILLNESS",
  "FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK", "FINAL_UNKNOWN",
  "FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK"
)

cod_output1%>%
  filter(!if_any(all_of(cod_vars), ~ . == TRUE)) %>%
  count()

#27373 lots of missing 
```

now this section matches to the template based on just cause_of_death in both columns (leaving specific info out)

```{r causeboth}
template2 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,
    MANNER = cause_of_death,

   CAUSE = cause_of_death)
  
write_xlsx(template2, "COD Coding Input template_2.xlsx")
```


now this section leaves the cause column blank and only focuses on manner 
```{r onlymanner}

template3 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,
    MANNER = cause_of_death,
)
  
write_xlsx(template3, "COD Coding Input template_3.xlsx")
```


now this section leave the manner column blank and only focuses on cause
```{r onlycause}

template4 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,

   CAUSE = cause_of_death)
  
write_xlsx(template4, "COD Coding Input template_2.xlsx")
```
